title: Merry Making: Play, Build and Create With NVIDIA Technologies This Holiday Season

snippet: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board.
title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director
